contracts.write_order: Persist unmodified pending.native_applied_receipt, then source sidecar, then existing independent read.
contracts.source: Python sidecar copies only existing before/after snapshot fields. Missing fields stay absent. Native ABI/request fields unchanged.
contracts.recovery: Exact action/actor/target/build/SHA/fullID/gen; known episodes must match. Use exact retained row even with another same-target instance.
contracts.epochs: Only complete unchanged immediate session compares receipt/read epochs. Recovery never compares historical receipt epoch with fresh session epoch.
contracts.history: Recovery native_receipt=null; retained_native_applied_receipt/source keep original date. Fresh recovered_instance_observation.source_read stays separate. Missing source remains unknown.
contracts.compatibility: Existing ACK-only recovery unchanged. Stored-receipt recovery supports exact1.20.0.4; invalid/other provenance stays pending.
contracts.cost: Two extra small atomic ledger saves with source (one without source). No endpoint, Query or snapshot added.
contracts.durability: Real close+os.replace and fresh-process reopen; no fsync, power-loss, CK3 SAVE or runtime cold-restore qualification.
